run_execute_tests: run the lit test suite with a display, job count, and optional max time limit
run_execute_test: run a single test with the lit config and parallelism semaphores
run_execute_tests_in_pool: run tests in a multiprocessing pool with a job count and optional max time
run_consume_test_result: consume a test result from the worker pool and update the parent process display
run_abort_now: abort the current process immediately without exception teardown
